summary: Cadeler A/S filed a 6-K announcing completion of Cadeler plc's share-exchange offer, one Cadeler plc share per Cadeler A/S share, as part of the group's redomiciliation from Denmark to the UK. Roughly 7.94% of shareholders did not tender, lifting tendering holders' relative stake by 8.62%, and Cadeler shares began trading on the NYSE and Oslo Børs (ticker CDLR) on 5 November 2026. Holding over 90%, Cadeler plc will launch a Danish-law squeeze-out at NOK 58.42 cash per share, funded by a DNB facility. Watch the four-week squeeze-out window, delisting mechanics, and Nasdaq Oslo/NYSE liquidity migration.
